name: codebase-health
description: Repo-wide drift audit between docs, config, code, and architecture: verifies every factual claim against reality via parallel subagent fan-out, severity-rates findings, and reports read-only, delegating remediation to the implementation/verification lanes. Audit dimensions are configurable through a tracked codebase-health.md in the repository's convention home, written by the setup skill.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where the audit's optional rendered view goes, read by the shared medium resolver. auto (default): the view is offered and visualization:visualize picks the medium; terminal: no offer; file: local, never published; artifact or hosted: passed to visualization:visualize.

dimensions_file.title: Audit dimensions file
dimensions_file.description: A Markdown file of yours declaring audit dimensions (primary-sources, verification-sources, example-claims) for every repository, in the setup template's format. A repository's own codebase-health.md merges over it per dimension.
